title: Customer Read Client Permission Consistency

items.action: list, export, and read customer data

database.reason: No persistence model changes are introduced.

migration.reason: Existing customer read permission is reused.

backend.reason: Existing backend customer read authorization remains unchanged and authoritative.

api.reason: No server API contract changes; frontend client read calls now fail closed consistently.

tenant_isolation.reason: Existing organization-scoped customer authorization remains unchanged.

audit.reason: Read-only operations introduce no new auditable mutation.

route_guard.reason: This hardens reusable customer API client boundaries rather than route access.

notes: getCustomer already rejected locally when fair_crm.customers.read was absent, while listCustomers and exportCustomers still issued requests. The list and export paths now use the same fail-closed client boundary before any network request.
